title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct maximum kinetic energy of the nitrogen ions as 8.43 GeV.

title: Momentum Ratio
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly establish the momentum ratio between protons and nitrogen ions using their charges.

title: Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the energy-momentum relation to calculate the kinetic energy of the nitrogen ions.

title: Charge Consideration
description: Important Criteria: The student should recognize the charge state of the nitrogen ions and its effect on momentum.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should maintain consistent units throughout the calculations, ensuring clarity.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the energy calculations that could lead to incorrect results.

title: Mass Calculation
description: Optional Criteria: The student should correctly account for the mass of the nitrogen ion in the energy calculation.
